title: Fantasy Football Loser Flag — Last Place Punishment Gag
description:
Product overview:
This bold green scoreboard-style flag is made to shame (in good fun) the last-place manager. The printed phrase appears exactly as shown on the flag: Eyebrow: OFFICIAL LEAGUE RESULT; Main lines: "FANTASY FOOTBALL" on line one and "LOSER" on line two; Footer: LAST PLACE AND PROUD. The treatment is high-contrast, stadium-scoreboard inspired green with white text for an unmistakable loser label.

Verified product facts:
- Double-sided print (design readable on both sides)
- Suitable indoors or outdoors
- Printed to order
- Flagpole and mounting hardware are not included

Use occasions:
Perfect for draft day, end-of-season parties, toilet-bowl punishments, league gatherings, or as a gag gift to force the loser to display their failure at a watch party, home, or office.

Production and listing disclosure:
This listing and layout were created with AI-assisted tools and completed in partnership with a trusted print-on-demand production partner who handles printing and fulfillment. All flags are printed to order by that production partner.

Notes:
- Flagpole and mounting hardware are not included; order those locally if needed.
- Colors and textures may vary slightly by print run and weather exposure if used outdoors.

If you want a different size or a custom fabric option, message me and I can check availability with the production partner. (Listing content and layout created with AI assistance; final production by partner.)
rationale: Scoreboard style and green palette match the requested "green scoreboard treatment" and make the loser label obvious at events.
